text: ポケモン　２ひき　いないのね　あなたも　ポケモンも　ひとりじゃ　さみしいわよぉ

structure.jp: ポケモン　２ひき　いないのね
structure.en: you don't have two Pokémon, I see

structure.jp: あなたも　ポケモンも

patterns.name: 〜も〜も
patterns.span: あなたも　ポケモンも
patterns.explanation: も after two things in a row means 'both this and that'. あなたも ポケモンも = 'both you and your Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜では
patterns.explanation: では after a word means 'if it is that way', and じゃ is its spoken short form. ひとりじゃ さみしい = 'it's lonely if you're alone'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence is a soft, feminine way to state something, here with よ added to tell you so. さみしいわよぉ = 'you'll be lonely, you know'.
